weapons.title: Приказ: Сплошной Огонь
weapons.silhouette: spectral rifle rank behind a raised war banner
weapons.motion_path: three aimed volleys sweeping one straight arena-crossing lane
weapons.impact_language: three muzzle-flash waves that break on the first dense group, then a smoke recall

performance.v2_presence_note: FAN-3941: the authored formation plus the backdrop veil and hero cast pose; the veil is a gradient sprite with no material

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: with the shipped screen_shake toggle off the authored AnimationPlayer timeline plays exactly the same war banner, spectral rifle rank, volley lane and three muzzle-flash waves on the same timing, because the scene authors no camera-shake device: each volley is an alpha step on the lane and the rank's aim rotation is the beat
quality.measurement: FAN-3941 real-runtime certification capture: peak authored-scene opaque coverage 0.0293 of the viewport (alpha >= 0.5 on a paused scene-only render of the live cast started through UltimatePlayerHost, stride 2; the 1152x648 normal cast is swept every frame at 60 fixed fps and every committed frame is measured); the live scene authors no full-screen surface and the live cast never moves the Player camera; the fastest authored alpha track is MuzzleFlashWave at 0.94 Hz on a lane-sized element

weapons.title: Семь Секунд до Ада
weapons.silhouette: seven oversized grenades seeded around one aim point
weapons.motion_path: high lob, then a shared shrinking fuse countdown over the static seeded formation
weapons.impact_language: outside-in chain detonation closing on a central fire column and a short burning crater

performance.v2_presence_note: FAN-3941: the authored formation plus the backdrop veil and hero cast pose; the veil is a gradient sprite with no material

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: with the shipped screen_shake toggle off the authored AnimationPlayer timeline plays exactly the same lob arc, seven seeded grenades and shrinking fuse ring on the same timing, because the scene authors no camera-shake device: the fuse ring's contraction is the countdown read and its alpha pulse stays a ring-sized element
quality.measurement: FAN-3941 real-runtime certification capture: peak authored-scene opaque coverage 0.0369 of the viewport (alpha >= 0.5 on a paused scene-only render of the live cast started through UltimatePlayerHost, stride 2; the 1152x648 normal cast is swept every frame at 60 fixed fps and every committed frame is measured); the live scene authors no full-screen surface and the live cast never moves the Player camera; the peak is the chain-blast ring drawn from the executor's .detonate beats on the executor clock (4.7-6.5 s), each blast at a different point; the ring-sized FuseRing pulse is 1.14 Hz

weapons.title: Последняя Атака
weapons.silhouette: three offset ranks of ghost infantry holding levelled bayonets
weapons.motion_path: three time-offset phalanx charges down one aimed corridor, hero never displaced
weapons.impact_language: crossed-bayonet pin, then a short frontal guard and a rally salute

performance.v2_presence_note: FAN-3941: the authored formation plus the backdrop veil and hero cast pose; the veil is a gradient sprite with no material

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: with the shipped screen_shake toggle off the authored AnimationPlayer timeline plays exactly the same three ghost-infantry ranks, charge corridor, frontal guard and crossed-bayonet pin on the same timing, because the scene authors no camera-shake device: each rank's charge down the corridor is a positional step and the pin is a contrast cross
quality.measurement: FAN-3941 real-runtime certification capture: peak authored-scene opaque coverage 0.0184 of the viewport (alpha >= 0.5 on a paused scene-only render of the live cast started through UltimatePlayerHost, stride 2; the 1152x648 normal cast is swept every frame at 60 fixed fps and every committed frame is measured); the live scene authors no full-screen surface and the live cast never moves the Player camera; no authored alpha track rises more than once per cast

live_capture.note: Real-runtime four-mode frames per weapon and viewport through UltimatePlayerHost with the shipped Player, real Enemy scenes, a real hazard telegraph and enemy projectile and the live ultimate HUD adapter under a fixed 60 fps clock: the active beat and, for soldier_grenade, the executor-clock detonation/crater/final beats at every viewport, plus release/impact/recovery at 1152x648. `crowded` stands the declared crowd cap; `reduced_motion` applies the shipped screen_shake toggle (an intrinsic no-op for the Soldier scenes, measured as a zero camera trace); `photosensitivity_safe` additionally has no full-screen surface to suppress (measured zero). The four legacy resolution sheets above remain the FAN-1468 contact sheets.

certification.note: Real-runtime captures: one cast per weapon x mode x viewport through UltimatePlayerHost with the shipped Player (own current Camera2D), real Enemy scenes, a real hazard telegraph and enemy projectile, and the live ultimate HUD adapter, under a fixed 60 fps clock; the active beat and every payoff beat at every viewport plus release/impact/recovery at 1152x648. The capture manifest pins every file hash, the engine, the command, per-frame camera/world state, the measured coverage and the per-run camera-offset traces behind the mode effects.
